title: Brand Manager
description:
Brand Manager

Location: Leeds (Hybrid Working - 3 days office, 2 days home)
Salary: Up to 50,000 Basic + Company Benefits

Our client is a fast-growing consumer brand with a strong presence across retail, e-commerce, and digital channels. Known for innovation, creativity, and customer-centric product development, they are looking to appoint an experienced Brand Manager to drive brand growth.

As Brand Manager, you will take ownership of the brand strategy, ensuring consistent messaging and execution across all consumer touchpoints. Reporting into Marketing Director you will be responsible for delivering brand campaigns, managing product launches, and leading one direct report.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded marketing professional with previous brand management experience within consumer products, beauty, FMCG, or retail sectors.

Key Responsibilities:
- Develop and execute brand strategies to drive awareness, engagement, and revenue growth.
- Lead the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social, retail, and PR channels.
- Manage the full product launch lifecycle, from concept through to market execution.
- Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to identify growth opportunities.
- Work closely with sales, product development, and external agency partners.
- Monitor campaign performance and ROI, providing recommendations for continuous improvement.
- Manage and mentor one direct report, supporting their development and performance.
- Ensure brand consistency across all customer touchpoints.
- Oversee marketing budgets and campaign spend.

Skills Required:
- Must have proven experience working in a similar Brand Manager or Product Marketing/Consumer Marketing role
- Previous experience working within a consumer, FMCG, or personal care sector is essential
- Experience managing and developing at least one direct report
- Strong understanding of brand strategy, campaign management, and consumer marketing
- Commercially aware with the ability to analyse data and translate insights into action
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
- Experience managing agencies and external partners
- Degree-qualified in Marketing, Business, or a related discipline preferred

title: Campaign delivery analyst
description:
Campaign delivery analyst

Bristol or Halifax - hybrid 2 days per week

6 month contract

Inside ir 35

Department: Data and Analytics Delivery
Platform: Customer Communications Business Area: Chief Digital Office

Role Purpose

The Campaign delivery Analyst supports the delivery of data-driven, personalised customer communications that strengthen customer relationships and increase customer and organisational value. Working within a cross-functional team, the role focuses on campaign delivery, customer data analysis and continuous improvement across direct mail (DM), email and SMS channels.

Key Responsibilities

- Continuous Improvement: Enhance campaign processes, techniques and the interaction portfolio to improve customer experience, operational efficiency and risk management.
- Platform Transformation: Support the transition to new campaign delivery platforms, processes and operating models while maintaining effective campaign delivery.

- Stakeholder Collaboration: Work effectively across teams, communicate requirements clearly and identify opportunities to improve business outcomes.

Essential Skills and Experience
- Understanding of campaign management principles and processes.
- Experience using SQL or a similar coding language.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent planning, organisation and time-management capabilities.
- Ability to work collaboratively within a large team and independently when required.
- Effective workload management and a commitment to timely delivery.

Desirable Skills and Attributes
- Experience working with large customer datasets.
- Customer-focused, impact-driven and motivated to improve customer outcomes.
- Proactive in identifying issues, opportunities and process improvements.
- Strong stakeholder engagement, influencing and requirements-gathering skills.
- Adaptability when working with evolving technologies, processes and operating models.

Expected Outcomes
- Timely and accurate delivery of customer communications campaigns.
- Improved customer targeting, personalisation and channel relevance.
- More efficient campaign processes and reduced operational risk.
- Effective support for campaign platform and operating model transitions.
- Strong stakeholder relationships and measurable improvements in customer and business value.

Candidate Profile: An analytical, organised and proactive individual who combines technical capability, campaign management understanding and stakeholder collaboration to deliver effective, personalised customer communications.

title: Content & Social Media Executive
description:
Turn live construction projects into engaging digital content. Bring your photography, video and editing skills to Regiis Ceramics and help showcase our work across social media and the web.

Content & Social Media Executive

Regiis Ceramics
Location: Leeds office, with travel to sites nationally
- Salary: £28,000-£32,000 per year, depending on experience
- Full-time, Monday to Friday
- Company electric vehicle provided

About Us

Regiis Ceramics is a commercial tiling contractor working for main contractors across the leisure, retail, hospitality, automotive and healthcare sectors.

We are growing fast and want our work seen. We're looking for a creative, organised Content & Social Media Executive to capture our projects and keep our digital channels active, consistent and engaging.

About the Role

Based at our Leeds office, you will travel to live sites and completed projects nationally, capturing photography, video, reels and drone footage that showcase our work.

You will manage our digital channels and work closely with our external marketing agency to keep content on brand and published on time.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Manage our website, Google Business Profile, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, posting social content five days a week in line with our house format and brand guidelines.
- Visit live sites and completed projects nationally to capture photos, videos, reels and drone footage, then edit content for each channel.
- Update the website with project case studies, photos, news and recruitment pages, and support recruitment adverts.
- Keep our Google Business Profile active with weekly project photos, updates and posts, and respond to reviews and Q&As.
- Work with our external marketing agency, supplying site content and project details, coordinating the content calendar and ensuring everything is published on brand and on time.
- Build and manage a content library for every job.
- Track engagement, enquiries, website traffic and Google profile views, providing monthly reports.

About You

You will be a confident content creator with an essential portfolio of photography and video work. Organised and proactive, you will be comfortable managing your own time and working independently.

You will also bring:
- Confidence using editing tools such as CapCut, Premiere, Lightroom or similar.
- Experience updating websites.
- A full UK driving licence.
- A CSCS card, or willingness to obtain one with our support.
- Confidence working on active construction sites while wearing PPE.

Basic SEO knowledge would be an advantage.

What We Offer
- A salary of £28,000-£32,000, depending on experience.
- A company electric vehicle.
- Support to obtain a CSCS card if required.
- The opportunity to showcase varied commercial projects across the country.

How to apply

If you have the skills and experience required for this Content & Social Media Executive position based in Leeds, click "apply" today and check your inbox for an email providing more information on how to tailor your application and provide a cover letter or any supporting documents.

No agencies please.

Other suitable skills and experience include: Content Creator, Social Media Executive, Digital Content Executive, Content Marketing Executive, Social Media Coordinator, Digital Marketing Executive, Videographer, Photographer, Video Editor, Marketing Executive.

title: Content Writer
description:
Role: Content Writer - Leeds

Salary: £27k- £30k DOE per annum

WorkingHours: Monday to Friday 9am-5pm

Benefits:
- Flexible working offered
- Hybrid working offered
- Pension
- 20 days holidays + stats
- Onsite parking
- Free tea and coffee
- Progression opportunities

We're working with a well-established, design-led interiors brand based in Leeds who are on the lookout for a Content Writer.

This fast-paced role is ideal for a wordsmith, someone who can write with clarity and incisiveness, and that can create stunning copy for all audiences, while maintaining a house style and consistent tone of voice.

Working alongside both our internal and external stakeholders, your primary responsibility will be using this writing ability to create compelling and eye-catching product listings on our website. This includes researching and writing informative, persuasive and engaging descriptions that provides customers with all they need to know to make a purchase, as well as creating and adding imagery and videos that truly showcases the products. You will also need to have the ability to turn complicated and technical information into simple copy for all to understand.

Additionally, will also be managing existing and older products to keep information fresh and up-to-date, ensuring that the latest information is always provided, and helping to mitigate customer service issues.

You will also support our wider marketing team with creation of new brand and product categories, writing SEO-optimised content to assist with our overall digital marketing strategy.

This role also provides long-term opportunities to assist across multiple channels and platforms, including creating guides, videos, and social media content for our in-house magazine and customer buying guides, as well as support the wider marketing team by generating copy for other channels such as email marketing. Any demonstrable experience and skills in these areas would be hugely beneficial for the successful candidate.

The Role
- Listing and addition of new products to the website using our bespoke in-house CMS
- Writing engaging and exciting product copy to accompany products being listed
- Editing and creation of any supplier-provided or in-house imagery, visual assets and videos
- Updating and checking of stock availability on products alongside our sales team
- Liaising with external stakeholders and brands to obtain any missing product information, required assets, or to clarify any information
- Managing existing products to ensure they are up-to-date with updated copy, and that any new information or product changes are added from new brochures
- Price checking and management, updating any price increases or decreases
- Creation of product and brand categories using SEO best practise, alongside optimised written copy
- Writing and creation of content for our blog/magazine in terms of guides, videos, and visual assets
- Ability to support with ongoing sales and marketing campaigns in terms of email marketing, social media and more.

Essential skills & Attributes
- Excellent written communication skills including grammar, punctuation and syntax
- Strong verbal skills to communicate with both internal and external stakeholders
- Excellent proofreading skills and ability to check own work, since you will be listing products independently
- Time management and efficiency as you will need to upload products at pace
- Knowledge of Content Management Systems / basic content uploading skills
- Fast-learner since you will need to get to grips with product & technical information quickly
- An eye for detail, since you will be observing any changes and making corrections/adding changed information
- Knowledge of Microsoft suite of software (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc)
- Excellent organisational skills to be able to plan and manage own workload
- Some knowledge of Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) and keyword research would be ideal, since you will be writing content that is optimised/maintains SEO best practise.

Desirable:
- Knowledge of bathroom/interior design/home improvement products, trends and styles
- Use of SEO and keyword research tools such as Semrush
- Experience of using Adobe software (Photoshop, InDesign, Fireworks, Premiere etc) or equivalent creative tools

title: Digital Marketing Coordinator - Maternity Cover
description:
About Dream Big Digital

Dream Big Digital is a boutique eCommerce and marketing agency based in Leeds, Yorkshire. We specialise in designing, building, and marketing online Shopify stores that excite customers and generate revenue. Our small but mighty team is passionate about helping ambitious brands sell more online through tailored, personal service.

We're now looking for a Digital Marketing Coordinator to join the team on a fixed-term maternity cover contract, supporting the delivery of day-to-day marketing activity across our eCommerce client portfolio. As the agency continues to grow, there may be opportunities beyond the initial fixed-term contract for the right person.

The Role

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone with a good grounding in digital marketing and a particular interest in eCommerce. Working closely with our Marketing Director, designers and wider team, you'll support the planning and delivery of email marketing campaigns, website merchandising, assisting with key trading initiatives and reporting.

A key part of the role will be helping our clients get more from their website and marketing, so you'll need to be comfortable thinking commercially about campaigns, products, promotions and customer behaviour.

You don't need to be a specialist in every area. We're looking for someone who is organised, creative, commercially aware and happy managing a varied workload across multiple brands.

Previous Shopify experience would be a big advantage, as would experience working with email marketing platforms such as Klaviyo.

What You'll Be Doing
- Supporting the planning and delivery of email marketing campaigns across our eCommerce clients
- Developing campaign ideas and writing clear, engaging email briefs and copy
- Working with designers to coordinate email creative and ensure campaigns are delivered accurately and on time
- Reviewing email performance and using results to help shape future campaigns
- Assisting with day-to-day Shopify website trading and merchandising
- Writing and updating website content, including blogs, landing pages and case studies, whilst supporting SEO and website content optimisation
- Merchandising and optimising client websites to support key trading periods
- Keeping up to date with digital marketing trends
- Working closely with the wider team to make sure client activity is delivered accurately and on time

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a digital marketing, eCommerce or similar role
- Experience supporting or delivering email marketing campaigns
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills
- Good commercial awareness and an understanding of how digital marketing activity can drive traffic, engagement and sales
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confidence managing multiple tasks, clients and deadlines
- A creative approach and confidence contributing ideas
- The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a small team
- A genuine interest in eCommerce and digital marketing

Particularly Useful Experience

These aren't essential, but we'd particularly love to hear from you if you have experience with:
- Shopify, particularly product management, merchandising or website trading
- Klaviyo or another email marketing platform
- eCommerce merchandising and website trading
- Google Analytics or other digital reporting tools
- Working within an eCommerce brand or digital agency

Benefits
- The opportunity to work across a variety of exciting eCommerce brands and industries within a growing Shopify Plus Partner
- Real responsibility and the chance to make an impact across client accounts
- A supportive, collaborative and creative working environment
- Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
- Real responsibility and ownership - your work will directly impact client growth
- Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid working (home-based with two days in Leeds city centre)
- Part of a growing, innovative team
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

Bradford

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Marketing Manager

Otley - 2/3 days in the office

50,000 - 55,000

An established and growing environmental and sustainability consultancy is looking to appoint a Digital Marketing Manager to take ownership of its marketing activity and help shape the next stage of its growth.The business is an SME and has built a strong client base largely through repeat business, referrals and its reputation within the market. They are looking to bring Marketing in-house and appoint someone who can develop and lead a more structured marketing approach.
This is a newly established position with significant autonomy. Reporting directly to the board, you will be given the opportunity to assess the current marketing activity, identify where improvements can be made and develop a clear plan for how marketing can support the wider commercial objectives of the business.
Initially, there will be a strong focus on digital lead generation, alongside improving the company's website and developing its approach across SEO, PPC, content, social media and wider brand activity.
You won't be expected to be a technical expert in technical consultancy. The business has experienced divisional heads and subject matter experts who will provide the technical knowledge, insight and content required. Your role will be to translate that expertise into effective B2 B marketing activity.
Key responsibilities:
- Take ownership of the overall marketing approach and develop a clear marketing plan.
- Review existing marketing activity and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Develop digital campaigns focused on generating relevant B2 B enquiries.
- Improve and optimise the company's website and digital presence.
- Manage and develop SEO and PPC activity.
- Build a more consistent approach to content and thought leadership.
- Develop the company's use of social media and wider digital channels.
- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and market presence.
- Work closely with divisional heads to understand their markets, customers and commercial priorities.
- Manage external agencies and suppliers where appropriate.
- Establish appropriate measures to understand marketing performance and return on investment.

About you:
The business is deliberately keeping an open mind around the exact background and level of the person appointed. They are particularly interested in speaking with people who have:
- Strong B2 B marketing experience.
- Broad digital marketing knowledge rather than experience limited to one channel.
- Experience across areas such as SEO, PPC, websites, content and social media.
- A commercial approach to marketing with an understanding of lead generation.

title: Office Administrator/Marketing Coordinator
description:
Office Administrator & Marketing Coordinator

Department: Administration & Marketing

Reports To: Company Directors

Location: Bradford

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and enthusiastic Office Administrator & Marketing Coordinator to support the smooth day to day running of the business.

This is a varied role combining general office administration, accounts support, staff training coordination, accreditation management, business development support and marketing activities.

The successful candidate will work closely with the company directors and wider team, helping to maintain operational efficiency, support business growth and promote the company's professional image.

Key Responsibilities

1. Office Administration
- Manage general day to day office administration and provide support across the business.
- Handle incoming telephone calls, emails and general correspondence.
- Maintain accurate company records, filing systems and documentation.
- Coordinate meetings, appointments and internal communications.
- Assist directors and colleagues with administrative tasks as required.
- Ensure office procedures and systems are organised and maintained efficiently.

2. Accounts & Finance Support
- Provide administrative assistance to the accounts department.
- Assist with processing purchase invoices, raising sales invoices and maintaining financial records.
- Support the monitoring of outstanding payments and supplier queries.
- Assist with purchase orders, expense records and general accounts administration.
- Liaise with the accounts team to ensure financial documentation is accurate and submitted on time.

3. Staff Training & Compliance
- Maintain and regularly update the company training matrix.
- Monitor employee training requirements, qualifications and certification expiry dates.
- Organise and book training courses, refresher sessions and assessments in line with the training matrix.
- Liaise with external training providers and internal teams to coordinate attendance.
- Maintain accurate training records and ensure certificates are stored appropriately.
- Proactively identify upcoming training requirements to ensure continued compliance.

4. Accreditation Management
- Monitor and maintain all company accreditations, certifications and memberships.
- Track renewal dates and ensure applications and supporting documentation are submitted on time.
- Coordinate with relevant departments to gather information required for accreditation renewals.
- Keep company policies, procedures and supporting compliance documentation up to date.
- Support accreditation audits, assessments and compliance reviews.
- Ensure the business maintains the certifications required to meet client and industry standards.

5. Business Development & Tender Support
- Assist company directors in identifying and researching new B2 B tender and business development opportunities.
- Monitor relevant tender portals and highlight suitable opportunities to the directors.
- Support the preparation, coordination and submission of tender documentation, PQQs and supporting information.
- Maintain an organised library of company information, accreditations, case studies and documents for tender submissions.
- Track tender deadlines and assist in ensuring submissions are completed accurately and on time.
- Work with directors to develop professional client proposals and business development materials.

6. Marketing & Client Presentations
- Create professional PowerPoint presentations for client meetings, tender submissions and business development opportunities.
- Assist with producing company brochures, capability statements, case studies and other marketing materials.
- Ensure marketing materials reflect the company's branding, services and values.
- Work with directors to promote the company's achievements, projects and capabilities.
- Support the development of consistent and professional external communications.

7. LinkedIn & Social Media
- Create and publish a minimum of one engaging company LinkedIn post per week.
- Develop content highlighting company projects, achievements, accreditations, training, team updates and industry news.
- Maintain a consistent and professional company presence on LinkedIn.
- Liaise with colleagues and directors to gather photographs, project information and updates for social media content.
- Assist with growing brand awareness and engagement with potential clients and industry contacts.

Skills & Experience

Essential:
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Previous experience in an administrative or office support role.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint.
- Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and prioritise deadlines.
- Confident working independently and supporting senior management.
- A proactive, flexible and positive approach to work.
- Professional and confident when communicating with clients, suppliers and colleagues.

Desirable:
- Experience supporting an accounts or finance department.
- Experience managing staff training records, compliance documentation or accreditations.
- Familiarity with B2 B tender portals and tender submission processes.
- Experience creating business presentations and marketing materials.
- Knowledge of LinkedIn company page management and content creation.
- Experience using Canva or other design software.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured against:
- Office Administration: Efficient completion of administrative tasks and accurate record keeping.
- Accounts Support: Timely processing of paperwork and effective assistance to the accounts team.
- Training Compliance: Training matrix kept current, with refresher training booked ahead of expiry dates.
- Accreditations: 100% of required company accreditations maintained and renewed before expiry.
- Tender Support: Relevant B2 B opportunities regularly identified, tracked and supported within submission deadlines.
- Marketing Materials: High-quality, professional client presentations and business development documentation produced on time.
- LinkedIn Activity: A minimum of one relevant, professional LinkedIn post published each week.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:
- Highly organised and detail oriented.
- Self-motivated, reliable and able to take ownership of responsibilities.
- Creative and confident in producing professional marketing content.
- Comfortable working directly with company directors.
- Able to manage competing priorities in a busy office environment.
- Keen to learn, develop new skills and contribute to the growth of the business.

What We Offer
- A varied and engaging role with involvement across different areas of the business.
- The opportunity to work closely with the directors and contribute to business growth.
- Opportunities for professional development and additional training.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- The opportunity to take ownership of key administrative, compliance and marketing activities.

Overall Objective

To provide reliable and proactive administrative support across the business, ensuring
office operations run efficiently, training and accreditations remain compliant, and the
directors are effectively supported with tender opportunities, client presentations and
marketing activities.

title: Sector Marketing Manger
description:
Role Purpose Sector Marketing Manger

This is a senior marketing role responsible for leading the development and delivery of marketing strategies for YPO's Procurement Services sector. The postholder will work closely with senior leaders and category teams to increase brand awareness, generate leads, strengthen customer relationships, and drive revenue growth. The role combines strategic planning, campaign leadership, stakeholder management, and performance analysis to support organisational objectives and commercial success.

Key Responsibilities Sector Marketing Manger

Develop and implement annual marketing strategies aligned to organisational and sector objectives.

Lead, plan, execute, and evaluate multi-channel marketing campaigns that attract new customers, increase engagement, and improve retention.

Drive qualified website traffic and generate leads for the procurement team.

Act as the marketing lead for Procurement Services, partnering with category leads to deliver agreed business priorities.

Oversee the creation of compelling content across websites, blogs, publications, email campaigns, and digital channels.

Manage the end-to-end delivery of email marketing campaigns, including planning, execution, reporting, and optimisation.

Monitor customer behaviour, market trends, competitor activity, and campaign performance to inform marketing decisions.

Identify and implement innovative marketing techniques, technologies, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Build relationships with suppliers, partners, and agencies to maximise collaboration opportunities and commercial outcomes.

Take ownership of customer touchpoints, communications, and marketing assets to ensure a consistent customer experience.

Planning and Organising

Lead extensive marketing planning to support delivery of the organisational strategy.

Hold full responsibility for marketing activity within the assigned sector, including forecasting, budgeting, campaign planning, timelines, and performance delivery.

Coordinate cross-functional planning with procurement, sales, customer services, finance, operations, and other internal teams.

Balance strategic priorities while responding effectively to ad hoc requests from senior stakeholders.

Continuously analyse and monitor campaign performance, using data and insights to optimise results and achieve objectives.

Problem Solving and Decision Making

Make strategic and operational decisions regarding the planning, implementation, and measurement of marketing activity.

Ensure all marketing activity maintains the integrity of the YPO brand and delivers a positive customer experience.

Influence senior stakeholders and sector leaders on marketing strategy, priorities, and delivery.

Recommend and implement tactical and strategic improvements that support business growth and organisational objectives.

Stakeholder Management and Relationships

Internal stakeholders:

Strategic Leadership Team

Marketing and E-Commerce Team

Procurement teams (Category Business Managers and Buyers)

Business Development and Sales Teams

Finance, Operations, Customer Services, HR, and other support functions

External stakeholders:

Customers

Suppliers

Strategic partners

Digital and creative agencies

Skills and Experience Demonstrated by the Role

Strategic marketing leadership

Campaign planning and execution

Lead generation and customer acquisition

Customer engagement and retention

Content marketing and brand management

Data analysis and performance reporting

Stakeholder engagement and influencing skills

Cross-functional collaboration

Commercial awareness and revenue growth focus

Project management and organisational skills

Personal Attributes

Strong communicator with the ability to explain complex information clearly and confidently.

Influential relationship builder capable of working effectively with senior stakeholders.

Proactive, analytical, and commercially minded.

Adaptable and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Fluent spoken English at Level 2 (Proficient) in line with the Fluency Duty requirements under the Immigration Act 2016.
